segments.text: Boss of the Otobe Group.
Second year student at Masumi Private Girls' Academy. The only daughter of the former boss of the Otobe Group.
She lost her parents a few years ago and became the boss of the Otobe Group.
The group changed direction significantly during her father's time, and became a group beloved by the local community, operating as a "handyman," and Shizuka has continued that policy to this day.
She doesn't particularly want to be called "boss" and aims to be a graceful and mature woman, but sometimes her bossy nature shows through.
She admires casino dealers that she saw in movies when she was young, and belongs to the "Magic Club" at school.
(She thinks that handling cards might be useful.)
She wants to treat Fuyuko as a normal friend, but Fuyuko tries to distance herself from her, so she is always trying to find ways to break that distance.
As the daughter and granddaughter of the boss, she respects Rio, who is steadily achieving her goals.
乙部組組長。
私立真純女学園2年生。 前乙部組組長の1人娘。
数年前に両親を亡くし、立場上・乙部組の組長となった。
組は父の時代に大きく方向転換し、地域に愛される組として「便利屋」のような活動を行うようになったのだが、
静果はその方針をそのまま引き継いで今に至っている。
「組長」と呼ばれることは特に望んでおらず、おしとやかで大人な女性を目指しているが、時折、親分気質が滲み出てしまう。
幼い頃に映画で見たカジノディーラーに憧れを持っていて、学園では「手品同好会」に所属している。
（トランプの扱いなど役に立つかもしれない、という考え）
冬子とは普通の友達として接したいのに、冬子が距離を取ろうとするため、いかにその距離を壊すかいつも試している。
組長の娘・孫娘という同じような立場から、しっかりと自分の目標を達成している里緒を尊敬している。

Shizuka's caretaker and bodyguard.
A second-year student at Masumi Private Girls' Academy.
She has no family and lives in a detached house of the Otobe family.
She used to live with her grandfather, but her grandfather was a wanderer, and Shizuka's grandfather was the boss of the gang, and was grateful to him for providing lodging and food.
She was told to return the favor to the Otobe gang when the time came, and when her grandfather passed away, she was taken in by Shizuka's family.
That's why she has grown up with Shizuka since she was a child.
In order to fulfill her role as Shizuka's bodyguard, she has learned various martial arts.
In a one-on-one fight, she is strong enough to fight on equal terms with an adult man.
She also knows how to handle various weapons.
She tries to treat Shizuka as her master and caretaker, but Shizuka treats her as a childhood friend and friend, so she is happy but worried about the distance between them.
She belongs to the "Magic Club" with Shizuka, but she is worse at magic than Shizuka.
She is pretty clumsy at everything except handling weapons.
静果の世話役＆護衛役。
私立真純女学園2年生。
家族はおらず、乙部家の離れで暮らしている。
元々は祖父と二人暮らしだったが、彼女の祖父は渡世人で、静果の祖父が組長だったころに一宿一飯の恩義があった。
そして、いざというときは乙部組に恩義を返せと言われていて、祖父がなくなったのを機に、静果の家に引き取られた。
そのため、静果とは小さいころから一緒に育ってきた。
静果の護衛役としての役目を果たすため、様々な格闘技を習っている。
1対1の戦いなら、成人男性とも互角以上に渡り合える力を持っている。
また、それとは別に様々な武器の扱いも心得ている。
静果に対してはあくまでも主人と世話役、といった立場で接するようにしているが、静果は幼なじみ＆友人として接してくるため、嬉しくも距離感に悩んでいる。
静果と共に「手品同好会」に所属しているが、手品は静果以上に苦手。
武器の扱い以外はわりと不器用。

A first-year student at Masumi Private Girls' Academy.
Her parents are famous magicians, and she lives almost alone because they travel all over the world.
She wants to become a magician herself someday, so she invited Shizuka and Fuyuko to start a "Magic Club."
Although she is the youngest in the club, she is the best at magic tricks and has become Shizuka's mentor.
She is a cheerful, playful girl with good communication skills. She is proactive and her motto is "When I think of something, I act on it right away."
She likes to play pranks, and often gets scolded for playing pranks on Fuyuko together with Shizuka.
She is quite skillful, and makes most of her own magic tools.
She also thinks up illusion tricks and writes them down in a notebook.
Since she spends a lot of time alone, she often stays at the Otobe house.
She always carries playing cards and magic coins with her.
私立真純女学園1年生。
両親は有名なマジシャンで、世界中を飛び回っているため、ほぼ一人暮らし。
自分もいずれはマジシャンになろうと思っていて、静果や冬子を誘って「手品同好会」を立ち上げた。
同好会では一番年下だけれども、手品に関しては一番上手で、静果の師匠的なポジションになっている。
明るいお調子者で、コミュ力高め。
行動力があり「思いついたら即実行」がモットー。
悪戯好きで、静果と一緒に冬子に悪戯を仕掛けてはよく怒られている。
かなり器用で、手品道具もだいたい自作している。
またイリュージョンのトリックを考えてネタ帳に書きためている。
一人で過ごす事が多いため、よく乙部家に泊まりに来る。
トランプやマジック用のコインは常に持ち歩いている。

A third-year student at Masumi Private Girls' Academy.
The only daughter of the president of a financial systems company.
Her father is a genius programmer, and she inherited that talent.
She has a quiet and calm personality, and is often seen as more mature than the upperclassmen.
She is a member of the library committee, and became friends with Shizuka, who often comes to the library, over books.

At first glance, people tend to think she is not good at sports, probably because she looks like a literary girl, but she is a member of the track and field club and has participated in the national championships in pole vaulting.
For the same reason, people tend to think she is not good at math, but it is actually her best subject.
She is also a member of the "Magic Association" as a way of lending her name to the others.
In the future, she wants to help her father's company grow.
私立真純女学園3年生。
金融系システム会社の社長の1人娘。
父は天才的な才能を持つプログラマーで、彼女もその才能を受け継いでいる。
物静かで落ち着いた性格で、上級生の中でもより大人びた印象をもたれる事が多い。
図書委員をしていて、よく図書室にくる静果と本の話で仲良くなった。
一見、文学少女風の外見をしているためか、スポーツは苦手だと思われがちだが、陸上部に所属していて棒高跳びで全国大会へも出場している。
同じような理由で数学系も苦手と思われがちだが、大の得意科目だったりする。
名前貸しのような形で、一応「手品同行会」にも所属している。
将来は父の会社を大きくする手助けをしたいと思っている。

The second-in-command of the Yakumo Group.
He is like an older brother to Rio and Mimu.
He is indebted to the leader of the Yakumo Group and works hard for the group.
He is trusted by the leader, executives, and other members, and they rely on him.
He has had a bad relationship with Inami since they were in the group.
Translated from the official site
耶雲組の若頭。
里緖や未夢にとっては歳の離れた兄のような存在。
耶雲組長に恩があり、耶雲組の為に尽力しており、組長や幹部・他組員たちからの信頼も厚く、頼られている。
印南とは、組にいる時から仲が悪かった。
耶雲組の若頭。
里緖や未夢にとっては歳の離れた兄のような存在。
耶雲組長に恩があり、耶雲組のために尽力している。
組長や幹部・他組員たちからの信頼も厚く、頼られている。
印南とは、組にいる時から仲が悪かった。
She is the granddaughter of the boss of the Yagumo-gumi.
She is a nurse.
She previously had a difficult experience when she was caught up in a power struggle between the gangs, but she has renewed her resolve and achieved her goal of becoming a nurse.
She currently works at a hospital near the Otobe-gumi, and lives alone as it is far from her parents' home.

She is engaged to Amamiya Seiichi, the young boss of the Yagumo-gumi, whom she has admired for a long time, and is currently making various preparations for her wedding. The previous and previous previous bosses of the Yagumo-gumi and Otobe-gumi were good friends, so Rio and Shizuka have been meeting since they were young.
As they are in similar positions, they have been talking to each other since they were young, and they treat each other like a second sister.
Now they live nearby, so they often visit Shizuka's house.
Boss of the Shikama Group.

On the surface, the group has disbanded, but in reality it remains intact and is involved in a wide range of shady activities, including assassinations, illegal drug trafficking, and underground casinos.

Through this, he became close friends with Shintaro, the chairman of Uozumi Real Estate, and acted as a secret force for Shintaro's business, playing a key role in growing Uozumi Real Estate into a huge corporation.
Translated from the official site
Chairman of major developer Uozumi Real Estate.
At first glance, he appears to be a clean, large company, but he originally started out as a shady land speculator and his business style is ruthless when it comes to making a profit.
He likes money and women.
Translated from the official site
A second-year student at Kuroyo Academy.
The son of the president of Uozumi Real Estate.

He's not particularly good at studying and is full of insecurities, but because his parents are big shots, even if his grades aren't particularly good, he's sure to get a backdoor admission to a prestigious university through his parents' connections.
